basic_info.description: Huge price drop! Priced to sell. Bathed in sunlight, this southeast-facing corner residence sits in one of Pacific Heights' most established and sought after buildings. This well-appointed 2 bed, 2 bath residence with peek-a-boo views of the Bay features floor-to-ceiling windows with automatic shades, refinished white oak floors, and yes, in-unit laundry and earthquake insurance! Independent parking with E/V charging means you never have to worry about parking or charging up. The building itself includes a lobby attendant and great amenities, including a shared rooftop deck with panoramic views of the Bay, the Golden Gate Bridge and the San Francisco skyline. HOA dues include water, garbage, radiant heat, basic cable, internet, elevators, lobby attendant, professional outside management, building insurance, earthquake insurance. Ideally located just blocks from Union, Fillmore, and Polk Streets, and only three blocks from Lafayette Park.
